mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry (member_id, category, title, content, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiry WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET answer = #{answer}, answered_by = #{answeredBy}, answered_at = NOW(), status = 'ANSWERED' WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
